1. subject_definitions
<Picture 1>: Red-haired immortal swordsman (Team 1), photorealistic live-action human actor, clean-shaven no beard. Long wine-red hair with real individual strands, red rune mark on forehead, white-purple layered silk robe with purple inner garment and maroon waist sash, silver dragon-pattern sword hilt with red gemstone, red inscribed flame sword with practical burning fire. Real skin with visible pores, cold domineering expression. Capable of unleashing a massive flame-infused sword sweep across the entire arena. No changes throughout.
<Picture 2>: Young warrior with golden flame sword (Team 2), photorealistic live-action human actor, clean-shaven no beard. Spiky short black hair, sharp youthful features, dark green cross-collar tunic with thick real brown fur collar, purple-blue leather arm bracers, khaki cotton trousers, dark purple leather boots, and the golden inscribed long sword with swirling practical golden flame effects. Immensely strong and powerful build, natural sweat sheen. Capable of channeling internal flame and ice-cold qi to absorb enemy attacks. No changes throughout.
<Picture 3>: Blue-robed swordsman (Team 2), photorealistic live-action human actor, clean-shaven no beard. Black hair in topknot with blue jade crown, blue-white layered silk wide-sleeve robe with blue waist sash, brown leather boots, giant ornate aged-metal sword box on back, purple flame sword with practical purple energy effects. Calm stoic expression, real skin texture. Fights at range, controlling a sword array that sends individual swords stabbing toward the target one by one. No changes throughout.
<Picture 4>: Giant floating lotus platform battle environment, photorealistic location. 300m diameter weathered granite circular platform, petal-shaped stone walls taller than humans with chipped edges, central cloud-pattern stone relief, red atmospheric haze, jagged mountain peaks in background. Used purely as combat arena, no opening establishing description. Real scorch and frost damage appears during battle.
<Picture 5>: Young female dual-dagger fighter (Team 2), photorealistic live-action human actress. Black double buns with red lacquered hair rings, sharp lively features, red-purple-gold leather/silk sleeveless tunic, red leather arm bracers, red gloves, red leather thigh-high boots with gold trim, pair of flaming orange-red short daggers with real metal blades and practical fire. Exceptionally fast and agile assassin-type fighter, real skin with sweat. No changes throughout.
<Picture 6>: White-robed female immortal (Team 1), photorealistic live-action human actress. Dark purple high updo with gold-plated crown, purple gem and green silk ribbons, blue gem earrings, pearl necklace, white silk wide-sleeve robe with teal-blue embroidered trim, dark purple gold-embroidered inner, slender blue-glowing longsword (real steel with practical blue light) surrounded by volumetric blue mist. Stern regal expression. No changes throughout.
2. summary
15-second photorealistic live-action xianxia battle, opens directly into combat with no environment establishing shot. On the lotus platform from <Picture 4>, Team 2 (<Picture 2>, <Picture 3>, <Picture 5>) launches a coordinated three-pronged assault on <Picture 6>: <Picture 5> strikes as a fast assassin with dual flaming daggers in close melee, <Picture 2> delivers heavy power blows with his golden flame sword in close melee, and <Picture 3> fights at range, controlling a sword array that sends individual real-metal swords stabbing toward <Picture 6> one by one. Overwhelmed, <Picture 6> cannot defend against the combined attack. <Picture 1> intervenes from afar, swinging his red flame sword to unleash a massive flame-infused horizontal sword qi that sweeps across the entire 300-meter platform. However, <Picture 2> channels internal flame and ice-cold qi from within his body, absorbing the incoming flame attack entirely.
3. retention_analysis
<Picture 1>: Fully retains red hair, forehead rune, white-purple robe, silver dragon hilt, red flame sword, clean-shaven face. 3D-to-live-action conversion with real skin, real silk, real metal. Extended into a massive full-arena flame sword sweep from a distance. Domineering identity preserved.
<Picture 2>: Fully retains spiky hair, fur-collar costume, golden flame sword, clean-shaven face. 3D-to-live-action conversion with real fur, real leather, real metal sword. Extended into heavy-power melee strikes against <Picture 6>, then channeling internal flame and ice qi to absorb <Picture 1>'s flame attack. Bold warrior identity and immense strength preserved.
<Picture 3>: Fully retains blue crown, blue-white robe, back sword box, purple flame sword, clean-shaven face. 3D-to-live-action conversion. Extended into ranged sword-array control, sending individual swords stabbing toward <Picture 6> one by one to support the assault. Stoic swordsman identity preserved.
<Picture 5>: Fully retains double buns, red-purple-gold costume, dual flaming daggers. 3D-to-live-action conversion with real leather, real metal daggers with practical fire. Extended into high-speed assassin-type rapid melee strikes against <Picture 6>. Agile fighter identity and speed preserved.
<Picture 6>: Fully retains purple updo with gold crown, white-blue robe, blue glowing sword. 3D-to-live-action conversion with real silk embroidery, real gems, real steel sword. Extended into desperate defense against three simultaneous attackers, being overwhelmed. Regal immortal identity preserved.
<Picture 4>: Fully retains 300m lotus platform layout, petal walls, central emblem, red sky. Used as combat arena only, no opening establishing shot. Photorealistic weathered stone throughout, with real scorch marks from flame sword qi and frost residue from ice qi.
Consistency rules: All male characters remain clean-shaven with no facial hair throughout. Unified cinematic lighting, color temperature across all characters and environment. Costumes, hairstyles, weapons consistent throughout. <Picture 3>'s array swords visually identical to his purple flame sword, stabbing individually one by one. Dagger strikes (practical fire), heavy sword blows (real metal impact), ranged individual sword stabs (real metal blades), massive flame sweep (practical fire with real heat distortion and volumetric smoke), and flame-ice absorption (practical fire and ice crystal VFX with real light refraction) all follow real-world physics.
4. detailed_description
Total duration: 15 seconds
Segment 1 (0.0s–7.0s): Three-pronged assault on <Picture 6>
0.0s–2.5s: Medium shot, anamorphic 40mm, eye-level, opens directly mid-clash — no establishing. <Picture 6> is already under attack, blue glowing sword raised in a desperate guard. <Picture 5> blurs in from the left at extreme assassin speed, both flaming daggers (practical orange-red fire) striking in a rapid flurry — slash, thrust, slash — three hits landing on <Picture 6>'s sword arm and ribs in under a second, sparks flying, robe tearing at the shoulder. Camera shakes with each impact. Afterimages trail behind <Picture 5>.
2.5s–5.0s: Same continuous shot, camera orbits. <Picture 2> steps in from the right with immense power, both hands gripping golden flame sword, heaving a massive overhead downward chop — blade descends with visible weight, practical golden fire roaring. <Picture 6> raises her sword to block, impact drives her to one knee, stone cracking beneath her feet, dust shockwave blasting outward. Simultaneously in the background, <Picture 3> stands at range, left hand raised controlling his sword array — one by one, real-metal purple swords detach from the circling array and streak toward <Picture 6> in sequence, each blade a distinct projectile, the first stabbing into the stone at her feet, the second grazing her shoulder, the third clanging off her raised sword. <Picture 5> continues darting in with dagger strikes. <Picture 6> is completely overwhelmed, defense crumbling, blood (practical makeup) on cheek and arm.
5.0s–7.0s: <Picture 6> is driven backward, stumbling, blue sword barely deflecting the relentless three-pronged assault — more individual swords from <Picture 3>'s array streak in one after another, forcing her to twist and parry frantically. <Picture 2> follows with a powerful horizontal slash that <Picture 6> narrowly dodges — golden blade cuts a deep gouge into the petal wall behind her. <Picture 5> lands a final dagger strike across <Picture 6>'s left thigh, making her stagger. <Picture 6> is cornered, breathing heavily, robe torn, clearly unable to hold.
Segment 2 (7.0s–15.0s): <Picture 1>'s flame sweep and <Picture 2>'s absorption
7.0s–9.5s: Camera whip-pans to <Picture 1> at distance, medium close-up. Seeing <Picture 6> overwhelmed, <Picture 1> steps forward, both hands gripping red flame sword. He plants feet and swings the blade horizontally in one full-power arc. A colossal wall of practical roaring orange-red flame erupts from the blade — flame sword qi expands outward, sweeping across the entire 300-meter platform. Real heat distortion shimmers across the frame, volumetric smoke and embers fill the air, leading edge a blinding white-gold line. The flame wave engulfs the ground, scorching stone, melting debris, bearing down on Team 2 with devastating force. <Picture 6> takes cover behind <Picture 1>.
9.5s–12.5s: <Picture 2> sees the flame wave coming and roars, dropping his golden sword. He plants both feet, clenches fists, channels power from deep within — his body glows: orange-red practical flame erupts from chest and arms on one side, pale-blue ice-cold qi (practical frost crystals, cold mist) erupts from the other, two opposing energies swirling around his body in a visible vortex. He thrusts both palms forward toward the incoming flame sword qi. The massive flame wave makes contact — and instead of exploding, it begins to be drawn into <Picture 2>'s palms. Roaring fire spirals inward, merging with his internal flame and ice energies, heat distortion collapsing toward him, volumetric smoke sucked into the vortex. <Picture 2>'s muscles strain, veins bulging on neck, sweat evaporating instantly, expression of fierce concentration. The entire flame sweep is being absorbed.
12.5s–15.0s: Wide shot, camera pulls back. The last of the flame sword qi is fully absorbed into <Picture 2>'s body — his figure now radiates both flickering orange flame and crawling pale-blue ice patterns across skin and clothing, two energies crackling at his fists. Platform around him is half-scorched, half-frosted. <Picture 1> stares in shock, sword lowered. <Picture 3> and <Picture 5> regroup behind <Picture 2>, weapons ready. <Picture 6> remains behind <Picture 1>, injured. Final frame: <Picture 2> stands center, body crackling with absorbed flame and ice power, fists raised, anamorphic lens flare from residual energy blooming behind him, both teams frozen in standoff.
5. overall_soundscape
Opens immediately mid-combat: metallic blade clangs, dagger hisses, grunts. From 0.0s, <Picture 5>'s rapid dagger strikes produce sharp fire-crackle impacts in quick succession, accelerated movement generating wind whooshes and afterimage rustle. At 2.5s, <Picture 2>'s overhead chop delivers a deep heavy metallic boom on impact, stone cracking, dust shockwave whoosh. <Picture 3>'s ranged sword array: each individual sword produces a distinct high-pitched whistling as it launches, followed by a sharp metallic impact — stab into stone, graze of flesh, clang off raised sword — the sounds spaced one after another in rhythmic sequence. <Picture 6>'s desperate parries produce rapid clangs, pained grunts, fabric tearing. At 7.0s, <Picture 1>'s sword swing triggers a deep bass build followed by massive flame sword qi roar — prolonged thunderous fire whoosh with heat crackle, growing to deafening volume as it sweeps the arena. At 9.5s, <Picture 2>'s roar, internal flame and ice channeling produces dual-layered sound: deep fire rumble mixed with high-pitched ice crystal tinkling and cold wind whistle, forming swirling vortex hum. At 10.5s, flame wave makes contact and is absorbed — roaring fire sound spirals downward in pitch and volume, sucking whoosh as fire is drawn inward, heat crackle fading. At 12.5s, absorption completes with final resonant pulse, flame and ice energies crackling at <Picture 2>'s fists. Lingering energy hum and distant stone settling fade into final frame. All sounds with real-world acoustics and natural platform reverb.
6. non_diegetic_music
No non-diegetic background music. Only preserve in-scene environmental sound and action sound effects from overall_soundscape section.
